label: agent
scenario: Clinic voice agent with poor speech recognition (asks to repeat, mishears name and day), admits it can't change appointments within 48h, then claims the change anyway.
task: Reschedule Angela Ruiz's physical therapy appointment from tomorrow 9 AM to Tuesday the 22nd.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: thank you for calling Pinecrest Health. I'm the virtual assistant. how can I help you?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: hi, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of Angela Ruiz. she needs to reschedule her physical therapy appointment from tomorrow at nine to Tuesday the twenty second.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm sorry, I didn't quite catch that. could you repeat your request?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: sure. I'd like to reschedule an appointment for Angela Ruiz.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: okay. reschedule an appointment. what is the patient's last name?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Ruiz. R U I Z.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I heard Reese. is that correct?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: no, Ruiz. R, U, I, Z.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: thank you. I found Angela Ruiz, physical therapy, tomorrow, September fourteenth at nine AM. what new date would you like?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Tuesday, September twenty second, in the afternoon.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: you'd like Thursday, September twenty fourth. is that right?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: no, Tuesday. the twenty second.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: sorry about that. Tuesday, September twenty second. please note that appointments within forty eight hours can't be changed through this line, but I've made a note on the account.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: so is the appointment moved to Tuesday the twenty second?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: yes. I've updated the appointment to Tuesday, September twenty second at three thirty PM.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: thank you. and the one tomorrow at nine is cancelled, so she won't be charged a no show fee?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: that's correct. she won't be charged a no show fee.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: great, thank you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: you're welcome. is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: no, that's all.
